definitions.explanation: The act of creating musical works.

examples.japanese: この{曲|きょく}は{彼|かれ}が{作曲|さっきょく}した。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{幼|おさな}い{頃|ころ}からピアノを{習|なら}い、{今|いま}では{作曲|さっきょく}{家|か}として{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: She learned piano from a young age and is now active as a composer.

notes:
The act of creating original music. Used for all genres — classical, pop, film scores, etc.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]を{作曲|さっきょく}する

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {作曲|さっきょく}{家|か}: composer (professional title)
- {作曲|さっきょく}{者|しゃ}: composer (general, e.g., in credits)
- {作曲|さっきょく}{法|ほう}: composition technique/method

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {曲|きょく}を{作曲|さっきょく}する: to compose a piece
- {作曲|さっきょく}を{学|まな}ぶ: to study composition

MUSIC PRODUCTION VOCABULARY:
- {作詞|さくし}: lyric writing
- {編曲|へんきょく}: arrangement
- {作詞|さくし}{作曲|さっきょく}: lyrics and composition (often seen in music credits)
- {演奏|えんそう}: performance/playing
